description: This Java class 'AjaxPageableResponse' extends 'AjaxResponse' and provides a JSON serialization of a paginated response, including start row, end row, total rows, and data entries. It is likely used to handle AJAX responses with paginated data in a web application.

classes.name: AjaxPageableResponse
classes.description: A class that extends AjaxResponse to provide a paginated AJAX response with JSON serialization.

methods.name: getStartRow
methods.description: Returns the starting row index for pagination.

methods.name: setStartRow
methods.description: Sets the starting row index for pagination.

methods.name: getEndRow
methods.description: Returns the ending row index for pagination.

methods.name: setEndRow
methods.description: Sets the ending row index for pagination.

methods.name: getTotalRow
methods.description: Returns the total number of rows available.

methods.name: setTotalRow
methods.description: Sets the total number of rows available.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the response object into a JSON-formatted string, including pagination info and data entries.
